From: Uwe Schindler <uschindler@apache.org>
Date: Wed, 4 May 2011 07:05:47 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] SOLR-2493: SolrQueryParser was fixed to not parse the
 SolrConfig DOM tree on each instantiation which is a huge slowdown

git-svn-id: https://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/lucene/dev/trunk@1099340 13f79535-47bb-0310-9956-ffa450edef68

diff --git a/solr/CHANGES.txt b/solr/CHANGES.txt
index 3bef05499ef..831472aa7de 100644
--- a/solr/CHANGES.txt
+++ b/solr/CHANGES.txt
@@ -312,6 +312,9 @@ Bug Fixes
   did not clear all attributes so they displayed incorrect attribute values for tokens
   in later filter stages. (uschindler, rmuir, yonik)
 
+* SOLR-2493: SolrQueryParser was fixed to not parse the SolrConfig DOM tree on each
+  instantiation which is a huge slowdown.  (Stephane Bailliez via uschindler)
+
 Other Changes
 ----------------------
 

diff --git a/solr/src/java/org/apache/solr/search/SolrQueryParser.java b/solr/src/java/org/apache/solr/search/SolrQueryParser.java
index 34192b8fd8b..80db3314c7d 100644
--- a/solr/src/java/org/apache/solr/search/SolrQueryParser.java
+++ b/solr/src/java/org/apache/solr/search/SolrQueryParser.java
@@ -67,7 +67,7 @@ public class SolrQueryParser extends QueryParser {
   }
 
   public SolrQueryParser(QParser parser, String defaultField, Analyzer analyzer) {
-    super(parser.getReq().getCore().getSolrConfig().getLuceneVersion("luceneMatchVersion", Version.LUCENE_30), defaultField, analyzer);
+    super(parser.getReq().getCore().getSolrConfig().luceneMatchVersion, defaultField, analyzer);
     this.schema = parser.getReq().getSchema();
     this.parser = parser;
     this.defaultField = defaultField;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications Summary

#### Modifications in Each File:
1. **solr/CHANGES.txt**
   - Added an entry documenting the bug fix related to SOLR-2493, which states that the `SolrQueryParser` was modified to avoid parsing the SolrConfig DOM tree during each instantiation, preventing a significant slowdown.

2. **solr/src/java/org/apache/solr/search/SolrQueryParser.java**
   - Updated the constructor of `SolrQueryParser` to directly use the `luceneMatchVersion` from the `SolrConfig` instead of calling a method to retrieve it. This change optimizes the performance by eliminating unnecessary parsing of the SolrConfig DOM tree.

#### Relationships:
The changes in `SolrQueryParser.java` directly implement the fix described in the `CHANGES.txt` file. By modifying how the `SolrQueryParser` accesses the Lucene version information during instantiation, the patch addresses the performance issue highlighted in the documentation. The documentation serves to inform users and developers of the fix, while the code change provides the actual implementation of that fix.

@@ -312,6 +312,9 @@ Bug Fixes
   did not clear all attributes so they displayed incorrect attribute values for tokens
   in later filter stages. (uschindler, rmuir, yonik)
 
+* SOLR-2493: SolrQueryParser was fixed to not parse the SolrConfig DOM tree on each
+  instantiation which is a huge slowdown.  (Stephane Bailliez via uschindler)
+
 Other Changes
 ----------------------

### Modifications in Each File:

1. **SolrQueryParser.java**
   - The constructor of the `SolrQueryParser` class was modified to change the way it retrieves the Lucene version. The original line:
     ```java
     super(parser.getReq().getCore().getSolrConfig().getLuceneVersion("luceneMatchVersion", Version.LUCENE_30), defaultField, analyzer);
     ```
     was changed to:
     ```java
     super(parser.getReq().getCore().getSolrConfig().luceneMatchVersion, defaultField, analyzer);
     ```
   - This change eliminates the need to parse the SolrConfig DOM tree on each instantiation of `SolrQueryParser`, which improves performance.

2. **CHANGES.txt**
   - An entry was added to document the bug fix under the "Bug Fixes" section. It states that the `SolrQueryParser` was fixed to avoid parsing the SolrConfig DOM tree on each instantiation, which significantly reduces slowdown.

### Relationships:
- The modification in `SolrQueryParser.java` directly addresses the performance issue described in the `CHANGES.txt` entry. By changing the constructor to use a pre-existing member variable (`luceneMatchVersion`) instead of invoking a method that parses the SolrConfig DOM tree, the patch improves efficiency during the instantiation of the `SolrQueryParser` class. The entry in `CHANGES.txt` serves to inform users about this significant performance enhancement.
